horoscopes.horoscope: You may want to meet up with friends you haven’t met in a long time, and the stars indicate that you will have great fun. Your enthusiasm will add a glow to whatever you do. Your sincerity in approach is what makes it special, says Ganesha. Are you planning to steal someone’s heart. If so, today is the good day to do so. Your dashing personality armed with sheer confidence will definitely tame your desired partner, feels Ganesha. You are a flamboyant casanova today to romance with someone. Ganesha foresees that today your health may cause some anxiety. No major health issues are likely, but indigestion may spoil your mood. To maintain good health, you must eat at regular time intervals. Also avoid junk food, spicy eatables and stale meals. Ganesha feels that you shall be in a very generous mood today, and you shall not shy away from helping not only those who are close to you but also you will go out of your way to help strangers. Today you will brace yourself to face the upcoming challenges. You will experiment with your work in order to find the right solutions for you. Your strong ability to think, imagine and understand will help you to climb the ladder of success at a faster pace.

You will focus on nurturing the positive aspects of your life today, says Ganesha. You might exhaust yourself mentally trying to set things straight. It would be better to brainstorm with someone close to you or approach people whom you have differences with. The nitty-gritty is fine, but do not forget the larger picture, suggests Ganesha. Domestic matters will take most of your time today. Do not lose your temper on your beloved. You will get all the supports from your loved one. Play a soft romantic music around you and all your tensions will disappear, suggests Ganesha. Today, things may not happen as you had planned, and the results may not match your expectations, foretells Ganesha. Yet, you should remain composed and try your best to accomplish the tasks. But, not at the cost of your health. Today Ganesha advises you to be extremely careful while taking any financial decision that’s concerns the commodity or stock market. Speculative transaction must be totally avoided. Work will take a backseat today. You have to face a lot of challenges from the professional front. You need to prove people that you are a sincere worker. Failing to do so may create a wrong impression in the mind of your superiors.

Routine work bores you, and today you will go all out to break free from the shackles of boredom. The results, however, may not be as dramatic. You will have to depend on your children, if any, to rescue you from the tyranny of routine. Monetary gains can be expected either in the form of inheritance of ancestral property or as increment in your basic salary. The hectic day at work will force you to meet your lover. You will be in a mood to express your emotion freely in a manner that you will get oodles of kisses and hugs from your lover, says Ganesha. You will develop romantic relationship gradually, says Ganesha. Health problem is not at all an issue for you today. However, you will have to avoid verbal confrontations and arguments with others. Arguments may eat up both your time and energy. Try to relax, clear your thoughts and stay positive. Today is neither lucky nor unlucky for you in money matters. On the financial front, it is likely to be a dull day, and Ganesha advises you no to take any important financial decisions. It’s your day out with the bosses, says Ganesha. You’ll be busy in indoor meetings with your superiors. However, don’t let that get to your head and avoid bossing around your juniors. Maintaining a harmonious relationship will be profitable in the long run, feels Ganesha.

You may feel like flaunting your so-called superior social and financial status today. Chances are that all that gas about how successful you are may end up exploding in your face, and you may end up spending a lot more than you would have liked. However, if you only stick to buying a household item for your spouse, it may turn out to be a pretty satisfying day. Bring the fun back in your love life. It’s time to get naughty, says Ganesha. Play some interesting indoor games with your partner. It will create your mood for romance. Take your beloved for a film, and make sure you choose the darkest corner. Ganesha feels you will not face any major health issue today. However, your sensitivity will remain very high. Do activities which make you feel good, this would reduce your stress. Don’t be over reactive to situations, be flexible and sometimes diplomatic. Ganesha foresees that today you are likely to have some good financial gains. Your financial stability will also be good as the planets are favourably aligned for you. Don’t be a Nosey Parker. You need to focus on your won work since there will be a chance to get affected by the informal gossips in the office. You need to rely on your practical knowledge. The results depend on how you execute strategies with your teammates.

If it’s a fresh start that you are looking for, then this day promises to give you just that, predicts Ganesha. If you have chalked out plans for your future, today you may go ahead and implement some. Remember that rushing blindly into anything is not the solution; it is always the slow and steady who wins the race. Consider executing your ideas in phases, advises Ganesha. It’s easier to achieve targets in good time when they come in manageable bits. Lucky Colour Deep Bright Yellow If you are bored in your love life, surprise your sweetheart with a teddy bear or maybe a trip to a lonely beach. There will be a plenty of joy if you introduce your soulmate to your family and celebrate this day with a lot of fun. Being in good health and humour today, you can handle many things. You will perform very well at workplace. However, your anger may heighten, if not careful which can take away lot of energy. You are blessed with the right use of energy today. Today you will go out and blow your hard-earned money on yourself. Ganesha advises you to try to curb the desire to spend money on wasteful luxury items, and save as much as you can. Your confidence will help you carry the day, says Ganesha. If you are not happy with your paycheck, it’s the time to talk to the HR and confidently ask for the hike. Your problem will get sorted out only if you show your confidence.

Today, your power and finance will be greater than ever before, says Ganesha. You will also be inclined to make monetary provisions for any future economic instability that may arise. The people around you will stand up and take notice of the leader in you. A word of caution from Ganesha: there may be unprecedented fluctuations in financial transactions. You may want to understand your partner’s sentiments. However, avoid being critical to her feelings. Get ready to listen to some music so that you can react brilliantly and eventually start teasing your sweetheart softly. Ganesha advises that emotions are a matter of heart and not mind. You should analyze situation before reacting to it. Small things and noise may irritate you. Besides, you will face an internal conflict between feelings and practicality. You need to take good care of your health today as it may not be good. Today you may end up spending more than you can afford. Though, generally you play within the budget and hardly overspend, today you may end up spending more than expected. You will chart out a plan or a timetable to achieve long-term goals. And, the day will be good on the professional front. However, planning new activities may not fetch desired results. Working on the important projects will boost productivity, says Ganesha.

Today promises to be a busy day that will keep you occupied. You may also engage in written correspondence to re-establish some old contacts. Ganesha doesn’t rule out optimum use of the phone for this purpose. When it comes to the work front, Ganesha predicts you will be asked to bring order to the workplace. Every day cannot be a surprise with a beautiful bouquet of roses. Tonight you may want to take your family out for a dinner or a film. Time will give you enormous fulfillment with your loved one. You will be able to develop the sense of belonging, feels Ganesha. You will maintain good relations with people around you. You will feel very connected with the people resulting in a sense of satisfaction. Besides, you will strike balance between work and life. Besides, you will take balanced diet which will keep you in good health. Today is a good day, feels Ganesha, for financial matters. You will be able to find good income through various avenues. Working for government will prove to be beneficial. Your desire to meet the important people from and outside your concern will be fulfilled today. You will be satisfied with the progress. You may like to pursue interesting hobbies like cultural studies, industrial relations, consumer psychology that are relevant to your profession.

You might find your spirit sagging as worries cloud your thinking. Small things might probably bother you in a big way. Do not let them bog you down as life is all about mind over matter. As the day progresses, things will begin to look up. Take a break from the rigmarole if stress begins to take a toll on you, advises Ganesha. You may feel that your love life is losing its charm. You may keep quite and spend the entire night alone thinking how to boost your romance. You need to be confident. Take a chill pill and everything will eventually settle down. The day is very good for you. You will prove your abilities at work. People will accept your authority which will make you feel good about yourself. You will be very enthusiastic today and will be able to finish off many pending activities. Today you are likely to make very good progress in your business. You will be able to get more business through people in authority, power. You will increase your contacts who will prove profitable. Be careful today as stars are not in your luck. Even a minor lapse in concentration might land you in a great trouble. Ganesha’s advice to you is to stay extra cautious and focused. Being attentive will give the best results in the long run.

Watch out for Cupid’s arrow today, warns Ganesha. Love will strike and strike hard. Alternatively, you may also find yourself in an argument with a loved one that ought to have been avoided. An evening of romance beckons. . keep the roses ready and the carpet rolled to heal any bruises you might have caused. You will relish your beloved’s company to the fullest. Today you are so happy that you will love to entertain your sweetheart by enacting some fun-filled role of an acclaimed actor or singing the most romantic song “ Take me to your heart, take me to your soul”. You will face no health problems. You will be feeling good with everything around you. Positive vibes will surround you. You will be able to present yourself well in front of others and will devote more time to your family as well. Ganesha feels that today you will be lucky in case of financial matters thus you will be willing to try your luck. You will not mind taking risks and you may also wish to invest money in some business. Today, your creativity and enthusiasm will get its due recognition, foresees Ganesha. Your killer confidence will be magnificent today. You will be more than happy to finish a project successfully. It’s the right time to start fresh new projects and your presentations will be duly applauded by everyone.

You may be attentive, as much as an eagle is while chasing its prey, but you still need to be careful when signing any important legal documents, advises Ganesha. Brokers and dealers, especially, are likely to incur heavy losses unless they take necessary precautions to avert misfortune. You may worry about the long-term relationship and commitment and may long for security. Your beloved’s support will make you feel safe and secured. If you still have any unknown fear, you need to sort it out with before you land in a major problem, suggests Ganesha. You should try to do something that boosts your energy level. This is because your energy level is likely to drop very fast today. You should not ignore any sign that indicates weak health. Energy saving remains very vital for you today. A today looks to be very average for money matters, you should avoid taking any financial risks. There will be possibility of losing money one or the other way so you should be extra careful. You may not come to the conclusions immediately. You need to avoid arguments or any form of conflict with colleagues. You will need to control your actions and reactions while dealing with others. Crucial matters need to be handled with extra care, says Ganesha.

Today, you’re up against those who want to get back at you. But not for nothing are you the king! Ganesha says you needn’t worry, as few can match your prowess. Amid all the hullabaloo, your spouse will be a supportive presence. Lucky Colour Light Electric Blue You are in a mood to experiment something new today. Ganesha says you will let your partner run the show. You may help him/her understand a situation and encourage to perform better. You need to also make sure his/her health is perfectly fine. You are suggested to do something for relaxation today. You should remain alert to deal with the problems but at the same time, you shouldn’t take too much stress, as it might affect health. Don’t let your mood be ruined. Today is very balanced in case of financial matters. You will not be spending much nor you will be gaining much. You will just try to maintain the status quo and carry on smoothly. You may be feeling particularly magnanimous today, but you should make sure that this should not ruin your work. You may chase after some amazing ideas and pour all your attention to execution. You may get help from your colleagues to transform your dream into reality.

Within adversity, lie the lessons of success; avoid having to resort to that philosophy by implementing your plans, if they are well thought out, in a phased manner. This will help you achieve your targets, says Ganesha. Ganesha says, you will need to be on your toes today. You are likely to burn a lot of energies, says Ganesha. So you may get hot tempered. You have to be particularly patient at home to avoid any conflict. Commitment is necessary to keep the romance alive, suggests Ganesha. Ganesha says you may face high level of sensitivity coupled with stress today. You need to be careful. However, you should remain extremely patient while dealing with people and situation. That’s the only way to remain in good health today. Day to day expenses are likely to increase today, foresees Ganesha. You will however be able to control your buying impulse which is good in a way. You may spend money on routine necessities. Your routine may get disturbed due to some technical problem. Try and finish the pending tasks as soon as possible. You need to keep patience so that you can achieve your targets or deadlines. Accept suggestions whenever your colleagues come to help you, advises Ganesha.
